title: Source-bounded Wang reconstruction makes 11 cases eligible for later materialization
research_question: Can source-printed lunar birth signatures support reproducible full-chart reconstruction without guessing ambiguous or missing inputs?
before_state: The 24-case Wang corpus had source-reviewed target-palace anchors for all cases, but full-chart materialization remained 0/24 and the prior method-policy readiness snapshot reported full expert replay readiness 0/24.
result: Product #545 / PR #554 adds a source-bounded reconstruction readiness layer. Visual source review classifies 22/24 birth signatures as source-usable and 2/24 as hard source blockers; 37 bounded candidate inputs are evaluated with pinned iztro-js 2.6.1 using astro.byLunar and explicit Zhongzhou settings. Results: 11 UNIQUE_ANCHOR_MATCH, 6 MULTIPLE_ANCHOR_MATCH, 5 NO_ANCHOR_MATCH, 2 BLOCKED_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE, 0 ENGINE_UNSUPPORTED. Only the 11 unique matches are eligible for a later full-chart materialization step. Current Product state names that materialization as the next work unit; actual full-chart materialization and full expert replay are not claimed.
key_insights: The reconstruction inputs are derived only from visually reviewed source-printed lunar birth signatures; OCR guesses, biography backfills and reverse-solving from the chart are excluded.
Explicit day alternatives and unqualified 子时 ambiguity are preserved as bounded candidate sets rather than collapsed to a single guessed input.

The pinned probe compares target-palace identity and its fourteen-major-star anchor, including source-explicit opposite-palace borrowing where applicable; this is not equivalence with every source-chart annotation.
The 11 unique matches pass a readiness gate for a later full-chart materialization step, not a full-chart or expert-method benchmark.
The six multiple matches, five no-anchor matches and two source-incomplete cases remain withheld.
negative_findings: Only 11/24 cases are eligible for the next full-chart materialization stage; 13/24 remain withheld.
Full-chart materialization remains a separate pending Product work unit.
Full expert replay remains blocked by method-pattern target-scope binding even after chart materialization becomes possible.
No real-world predictive validity, empirical probability or causal result is established.
unexpected_findings: Five source-usable cases do not reproduce the independent target-palace anchor under the pinned engine; these mismatches are preserved rather than force-fit.
The source itself contains two hard missing-input cases (one printed with day X and one incomplete across a page break), which cannot be filled from biography.

boundaries.empirical_status: No real-world outcome labels or predictive-validity test.
